I’ve been using the Ather Rizta Duo for some time now, and overall, it’s a very practical and family-friendly electric scooter. The first thing I really like is the wide and comfortable seat, which easily accommodates two people. It’s especially good for daily commuting and family use.Theridequality is smooth, and the scooter feels stable even on slightly rough roads. Acceleration is decent—not too aggressive—which makes it safe and easy to handle in city traffic. The pickup is good for short distances and regular use, and it climbs flyovers without much struggle whenridingduo.One of the biggest advantages is the storage space. The under-seat storage is spacious enough to carry a helmet and small bags, which is very useful for shopping and office use. The dashboard is simple and informative, and the overall build quality feels solid and premium, as expected from Ather.Charging is convenient, especially if you have access to a home charger. The range is suitable for daily use, and for city riders, range anxiety is not a big issue if planned properly.On the downside, the price is slightly on the higher side, and the charging infrastructure can still be limited in some areas. Also, for riders who want very fast acceleration, this scooter may feel a bit calm.Overall Verdict:The Ather Rizta Duo is an excellent choice for families and daily commuters who want comfort, safety, and reliability. It’s not a sporty scooter, but for practical, everyday use, it does its job very well. (4/5)

I would love to share my experience after buying the Bajaj Chetak EV. Choosing an electric scooter was a big decision for me, and after comparing several options available in the market, I finally decided to go with the Chetak. Looking back, I can confidently say that it was one of the best decisions I have made.There is also a strong emotional connection with the Chetak brand in my family. When I was around 4–5 years old, my family owned two Bajaj Chetak scooters. I have many childhood memories associated with those scooters, and they were known for their reliability and durability. That trust has been passed down through generations, and it gave me the confidence to choose the new Chetak EV.After using the scooter, I have been genuinely impressed with its overall quality. The build quality feels extremely solid and premium, unlike many other electric scooters that rely heavily on plastic body panels. The metal body gives a sense of strength and safety while also making the scooter look elegant and timeless. The fit and finish are excellent, and every component feels well-engineered.The ride quality is another aspect that stands out. The scooter is smooth, stable, and comfortable, whether I am riding through busy city traffic or on slightly uneven roads. The acceleration is linear, the handling is confident, and the braking performance inspires confidence. The motor is quiet, making every ride peaceful and enjoyable.The battery performance has also met my expectations. The claimed range is practical for my daily commuting needs, and charging the scooter is convenient. Since switching to an electric vehicle, I have noticed a significant reduction in my daily running costs. Themaintenancerequirements are also much lower compared to a petrol scooter, making ownership hassle-free.Another thing I appreciate is Bajaj's attention to detail. The scooter has a premium design that attracts compliments wherever I go. The digital features are easy to use, and the overall user experience feels refined rather than overly complicated. Bajaj has successfully combined modern EV technology with the trusted legacy of the Chetak brand.After experiencing the Chetak EV firsthand, I genuinely believe it offers a better overall ownership experience than many other electric scooters currently available in the market. It provides the perfect balance of reliability, quality, comfort, efficiency, and premium feel. If someone is looking for an electric scooter from a trusted manufacturer with excellent build quality and dependable after-sales support, I would wholeheartedly recommend the Bajaj Chetak EV. It has lived up to my expectations and has strengthened the trust my family has had in the Chetak name for generations.
